docker.update_command:
bash -c 'set -euo pipefail
ctr_updater_file="$(mktemp)"
trap '"'"'rm -f -- "$ctr_updater_file"'"'"' EXIT
curl --proto =https --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NoobCity99/CTRoadmap/2ea382b5f1ea982c6c7ed6b90d9b4f8acce30d0e/ctr_update.sh -o "$ctr_updater_file"
printf '"'"'%s  %s\n'"'"' 015ba16f3c42d114da94f9f6b4b5b855f69d9117a893c030871f25cf6b909a75 "$ctr_updater_file" | sha256sum --check --status
chmod +x "$ctr_updater_file"
bash "$ctr_updater_file"'
docker.notes: v0.10.0-beta expands Rack Builder with physical ports and cables, equipment and Rack finishes, top-mounted equipment, Direct/Backplane Drive Bays and Server Drive slots with matching Handbook documentation. Handbook notes gain code editing and language detection; Snapshot INGEST recognizes relationships assigned to previously imported tiles. Universal @@ field insertion, automatic IP/URL links and a dedicated Canvas / Diagrams preferences tab improve everyday editing. Host Updater 0.2.0 remains compatible. Snapshot bundles are pinned to published version 0.1.1, rebuilt with Go 1.27.3 and golang.org/x/text 0.41.0; Snapshot schema v1 and WhosThere 0.8.3 are unchanged. Standard Linux installs require a verified compatible host updater before update commands become available. NAS/Portainer: keep using your platform's native update workflow.
summary: Rack Builder ports, cables, finishes and top-mounted equipment
Drive Bay modes and Server Drive slots with Handbook documentation
Code editing and language detection in Handbook notes
Right Click any NOTES TAB to export individualy
